reviews.name: Jordan Zipperer
reviews.review: I had such a great experience with Ailin at Tramp Art Studios 🖤 She was incredibly sweet and patient with me the whole time, even when I was twitching during the tattoo 😭 She made me feel really comfortable and never made me feel bad about being nervous or jumpy. I also kind of sprung this piece on her last minute for my birthday, and she still absolutely KILLED IT. You can genuinely tell she loves what she does, and that really showed in the final tattoo. The detail, shading, and overall vibe came out even better than I imagined, and I’m completely obsessed with it. If only I could post pictures! 🥀✨
